# Welcome {.unnumbered}

This is the companion site for the course **Introduction to Time Series
Analysis**. It collects the lecture notebooks, interactive demos, and
class materials in one place. Code in the notebooks is folded by default:
click **Show code** to expand a block, or use **\</\> Code** in the page
header to expand all blocks at once.

## Course Materials

### Notebooks

Open a notebook in Google Colab, or download it and run it locally in
Jupyter, VS Code, or your favorite IDE (when working locally you are
responsible for installing the dependencies).

| Topic | Open in Colab |
|-------|---------------|
| AR(2) processes | [Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/github/febse/ts/blob/main/01c-AR2-Stationarity.ipynb) |
| Stationarity and ergodicity | [Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/github/febse/ts/blob/main/02-Stationarity-Ergodicity.ipynb) |
| Fitting AR/MA models | [Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/github/febse/ts/blob/main/05-ARMA-Fitting-Class.ipynb) |
